Within the zero–subject historical braid, *Aion* supports the Jungian psychic register and its symbolic totality, not the authorial `X/x` matheme. Freud's disciplinary admission of the unconscious, Jung's own account of religious psychic facts, and Erich Neumann's consciousness history require their distinct source records now queued for acquisition. ### Licensed essay use - Contextualise the essay's psychoid and quaternary discussions and qualify any appeal to “totality” by keeping it within Jung's symbolic and psychological register. ### Claim boundary - *Aion* warrants Jung's Christian and alchemical figures within their explicit source locations and disciplinary scope. QL's eight determinations, the essay's theological synthesis, and any attribution of a Self to computational systems require independent arguments. ## Consumption - **Stations:** §3/#0 and §4/#0–#3. - **Arguments:** [[Core Theorem Bridge]]; [[Arche-Topos as Differential Field]]; [[Paradox as Cross-Register Hinge]]. - **Source relation:** contextualises and qualifies; the QL matheme remains in-house derivation. ## Quote and excerpt ledger | quote_id | exact text / excerpt file | locator | transcription | verification | consuming claim | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | — | No quotation admitted; contextual paraphrase locations recovered below. | AION-P01–P16 | private reading extraction, not a quotation transcription | `no-excerpts` | Selected-printing collation and quotation verification remain Open. | ## Provenance and acquisition - **Metadata source:** Oregon Friends of Jung library catalogue, checked 2026-07-14; corroborated by catalogue entries for ISBN 9780691097596. - **Text consulted:** selected passages of the user-local 1979 paperback reading carrier, 2026-09-08; paragraph/page map below.
